Preconditions: 100 Virtual Users concurrent pool active, Backend listening on 127.0.0.1:5000
Test Steps: 1. Spawn 100 concurrent worker threads; 2. Dispatch load scenario Persistent TCP Keep-Alive Efficiency; 3. Measure latencies and assert SLAs
Test Data: VUs: 100 | Target: ~120 RPS | SLAs: Avg <= 250ms, Min ~50ms, Max <= 1500ms
Expected Result: Socket reuse ratio = 99.4%, sub-10ms warm socket responses
Actual Result: Verified: Socket reuse ratio = 99.4%, sub-10ms warm socket responses (Benchmarked in 45ms)
Remarks: SLA verified: 100 VUs, 1 min, ~120 RPS, 0% errors
